jobs.title: Agent Product Builder
jobs.source: Employer Website — official public careers page
jobs.description: About Us: HighRadius is a pioneering, India-based autonomous finance platform that transforms the Office of the CFO for global enterprises. It automates core financial processes like Order-to-Cash, Record to Report, Accounts Payable, and Treasury. Operating at massive scale, HighRadius serves 1,300+ customers in 90+ countries, including giants like Redbull, Nike, Adobe, Unilever, Service Now, Warner Bro, L’Oreal, P&G, Nestle, and many more. In 2025 alone, the platform automated $25 trillion in invoices—a volume equivalent to 70% of the US GDP. Recognized as an undisputed market leader by Gartner, IDC, and the Hackett Group, HighRadius pairs global reach with deep R&D. Its 20+ product suite leverages proprietary AI like FreedaGPT, LiveCube, and 180+ orchestrated autonomous agents. Backed by 37 patents, the 2024 SaaSBoomi "SaaS Startup of the Year" sets the global standard for financial AI while uniquely committing to contractual business outcomes for its clients. Job Title: Agent Product Builder Role Overview In this role, you will be working on the following key problems: End-to-End Agent Development: Build, orchestrate, and deploy autonomous AI agents to drive 90%+ automation across Office of the CFO functions for Fortune 500 clients. Big Finance data transformation: HighRadius sits atop the world's most complex financial data; through world’s leading financial data transformation platform: LiveCube Deliver measurable value to Fortune 500 clients through Predictive forecasting, work optimization & prioritization, Anomaly identification, etc., leveraging Patent backed AI/ML algorithms. Unstructured Data processing: Custom Algos for Matching, Reconciliations, Parsing etc. core financial process which beat industry’s models by 50%+. The role is based out of the Hyderabad location. Key Responsibilities Agent Development: Independently design, code, and deploy autonomous agents from scratch to automate critical Office of the CFO workflows. Applied Data Science: Leverage Data Analytics for predictive forecasting, anomaly detection, and data reconciliation, directly impacting Fortune 500 clients. Performance Visualization: Design clear, intuitive data visualizations and tracking dashboards to continuously monitor agent health, prove out the 90%+ automation metrics, and communicate your product's impact to senior stakeholders. Full-Lifecycle Ownership: Operate as a self-contained builder. You will be writing product requirements; you will develop from the first line of code and model training to final deployment and iteration. Algo first thinking: Dive deep into massive, complex financial datasets. Write algos to solve NP Hard problems (Think Knapsack, or Mixed Integer Linear Programming but on Petabytes of Data). High-Intensity Execution: Thrive in a demanding, results-driven culture that values a "no excuses" mentality, speed of execution, and extreme dedication to hitting ambitious milestones and KPIs. Requirements Apply first principles thinking to break down and solve ambiguous problems Must possess Technical acumen and system design knowledge. Excellent Academic record from a top tier IIT Technical skills required - Functional Programming language (Pref. Rust), OOP (Python or Java), Distributed syst

jobs.description: About Us: HighRadius, a renowned provider of cloud-based Autonomous Software for the Office of the CFO, has transformed critical financial processes for over 800+ leading companies worldwide.Trusted by prestigious organizations like 3M, Unilever, Anheuser-Busch InBev, Sanofi, Kellogg Company, Danone, Hershey's, and many others, HighRadius optimizes order-to-cash, treasury, and record-to-report processes, earning us back-to-back recognition in Gartner's Magic Quadrant and a prestigious spot in Forbes Cloud 100 List for three consecutive years. Liaisoning with internal / external stakeholders to collate information, deliver insights and work with the sales leaders in driving engagement initiatives. This role requires a professional with high sales acumen, strong research, data analysis, and reporting experience. The individual should be able to communicate and engage with senior business leaders, and manage relationships independently. Desired Requirements Graduate / Post Graduate with 2-4 years of post qualification experience and exposure to research, data analysis, and stakeholder management Focused on Research skills and ability to use research tools Business acumen and analytical skills Ability to effectively collaborate with internal and external stakeholders Communication skills, both written and verbal Ability to work independently and manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment. Exposure to Salesforce and office productivity tools is a plus Prior experience in consulting / founder’s office / B2B SAAS pre-sales / marketing roles is a plus What You’ll Get Competitive salary Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/) Equal employment opportunities Opportunity to build with a pre-IPO Global SaaS Centaur

jobs.title: Deal Desk Analyst
jobs.source: Employer Website — official public careers page
jobs.description: About Us HighRadius offers cloud-based Autonomous Software for the Office of the CFO. More than 800 of the world’s leading companies have transformed their order to cash, treasury and record to report processes with HighRadius. Our customers include 3M, Unilever, Anheuser-Busch InBev, Sanofi, Kellogg Company, Danone, Hershey’s and many more. We at HighRadius firmly believe that a product is only as good as the people behind it. Whether it's product development, customer support, sales or operations, all our employees see the direct impact of their work. As one of the fastest growing FinTech software companies and a leader in the Fortune 1000 space, HighRadius focuses on hiring talented and motivated people from diverse backgrounds. If you want to channel your ambition and drive for success, you belong with HighRadius! Check out our company’s website to learn more about our fun culture, great benefits, read customer and employee testimonials, and more! Deal Desk Analyst A Deal Desk Analyst is responsible for providing analysis and support to the sales team in the form of pricing, discounts, contract terms, and product availability. Responsibilities Understand the sales process and develop deal structures to address HRC customers’ objectives Identify and manage escalations and internal objections related to pricing and other commercial terms Communicating ASC 605/ ASC606 governance rules and processes Optimize deal-making processes and knowledge management Be a business advisor to support and create a win-win transaction for the company and the customer in guidance with the pre-defined Governance Policies Consulting mindset approach when interacting with stakeholders and the sales organization Creation and distribution of standard and Non-Standard Enterprise License Agreement contract Building simple financial models and performing financial and data analytics to understand deal economics internal KPI performance Qualifications Any graduate or postgraduate with 2-3 years of work experience in Deal Desk The ideal candidate will be a self-starter who can work cross functionally and build strong working relationships with internal departments (Sales, Sales Ops, Finance) Problem solving ability and attention to details are essential Basic Legal Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance (LGRC) knowledge Excellent skills in oral and written communication documenting business justifications Excellent responsiveness to internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Design Implementation Consultant (AP)
jobs.source: Employer Website — official public careers page
jobs.description: About Us HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180+ agents that orchestrate end-to-end processes across Order-to-Cash, Close & Reconciliation, Consolidation & Reporting, Accounts Payable, B2B Payments, and Treasury. HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3-6 month go-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300+ enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and more. HighRadius has been consistently recognized as a market leader by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester. Job Summary The Senior Consultant is responsible for delivering the HighRadius Cloud product implementations of Fortune 1000 clients. He/She will be owning solutioning for client engagements throughout the project life cycle. The Senior Consultant is also responsible for delivering the design for the project on time with high quality, value and inline with Client project objectives. This is a highly visible and complex role since the candidate will be the main point of contact for project design and work with Client SMEs and stakeholders and Client users across client organizations. The candidate must have strong solutioning skills, well organized, detail-oriented, quality-minded and possess excellent written and verbal communication skills. He/She will be responsible for guiding the Consultant, Associate Consultant and Data Analyst to implement the design and achieve project objectives. . Key Responsibilities Perform blueprint design for one to many client projects for multiple HighRadius products. Gather business requirements, explore solution options, brainstorm solutions with internal team(s) and client team(s) wherever required to finalize design. Oversee consultant and through them Data Analyst and Associate Consultant to ensure solution is built per the agreed design. Ultimately accountable for project success by ensuring client achieves business value through a well defined solution design and holding the Consultant/Associate Consultant/Data Analyst accountable to outcome metrics. Keep the Delivery Manager and/or Program Director honest and up to date on any potential risks related to Solution design and/or Project value. Ability to produce actionable deliverables, influencing stakeholders to make informed design and decisions- Act as voice of reason within HRC and client teams. Skill & Experience Needed Bachelor's or Master’s Degree (preferably from a top reputed university). Strong solutioning, presentation and facilitation skills with small and large groups. Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand Fortune 1000 client business complexities and solution those. Overall 6+ years of professional services experience - Combination of Solutioning and delivery management experience. Minimum 2+ years of experience as Solution Architect/Technology Business Analyst or equivalent role preferably in a fast-paced consulting / professional services set-up. Experience in following the established processes/standards/templates to achieve successful results. Experience with Accounts Payable related business process is desirable What You’ll Get Competitive salary. Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/) Equal employment opportunities. Opportunity to build with a pre-IPO Global SaaS Centaur.

jobs.title: Quality Analyst
jobs.source: Employer Website — official public careers page
jobs.description: Job Summary: We’re seeking a Quality Analyst (2–3 years exp.) to design and execute test strategies for scalable web applications and APIs. You’ll collaborate with developers and product managers, validate functional and non-functional requirements, and drive automation coverage while ensuring high quality standards. Responsibilities: Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated test cases for web, API, and database layers. Perform API testing using Postman or automation frameworks (REST Assured). Maintain UI automation using Selenium WebDriver (Java/Python). Validate backend data using SQL queries. Manage defects through Jira, collaborating with development for resolution. Participate in Agile ceremonies, QA sign-offs, and release readiness reviews. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions). Perform cross-browser and responsive testing. Contribute to QA process improvements and automation coverage expansion. Requirements: B.Tech/BE in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent. 2–3 years of QA experience in manual + automation testing. Experience in Selenium WebDriver, API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured). Good SQL skills for data validation. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum workflows. Understanding of defect lifecycle and QA metrics. Good communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Support Operations
jobs.source: Employer Website — official public careers page
jobs.description: About Us: HighRadius, a renowned provider of cloud-based Autonomous Software for the Office of the CFO, has transformed critical financial processes for over 800+ leading companies worldwide.Trusted by prestigious organizations like 3M, Unilever, Anheuser-Busch InBev, Sanofi, Kellogg Company, Danone, Hershey's, and many others, HighRadius optimizes order-to-cash, treasury, and record-to-report processes, earning us back-to-back recognition in Gartner's Magic Quadrant and a prestigious spot in Forbes Cloud 100 List for three consecutive years. With a remarkable valuation of $3.1B and an impressive annual recurring revenue exceeding $100M, we experience a robust year-over-year growth of 24%. With a global presence spanning 8+ locations and a recent addition in Poland, we're in the pre-IPO stage, poised for rapid growth. We invite passionate and diverse individuals to join us on this exciting path to becoming a publicly traded company and shape our promising future. Job Summary: We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Support Manager to lead our Functional Support Consultant team. This team is responsible for providing high-quality support for our robust and scalable SaaS products. As a Support Manager, you will be a key leader, ensuring our team delivers continuous, delightful customer experiences and resolves issues efficiently. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership: Lead and manage a team of Functional Support Consultants, fostering a people-first mentality and a collaborative environment. You'll be responsible for coaching, mentoring, and developing your team to ensure they are the "ultimate HighRadian ambassador". Performance Management: Monitor team and individual performance against key metrics and SLAs. Use your knowledge of support KPIs to drive continuous improvement in areas like response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction. Operational Excellence: Oversee the day-to-day operations of the support team, ensuring that best practices for service delivery are followed. You will manage ticket queues, dynamically prioritize issues, and multitask as needed to maintain efficiency. Escalation Handling: Act as the primary escalation point for complex or critical customer issues. You will use your excellent communication and problem-solving skills to de-escalate situations, provide quick resolutions or workarounds, and ensure issues are driven to resolution. Customer Advocacy: Champion the customer experience by understanding and empathizing with client situations. You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to provide a "delightful customer experience". Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a liaison between the support team and other departments, communicating customer feedback and insights to inform product development and company strategy. Skills and experience needed Experience: Proven experience in a Support Manager role, preferably within a SaaS application environment. UK/US Client Experience: Demonstrated experience managing support teams that handle UK and US clients. KPI Knowledge: Strong knowledge and practical experience with key performance indicators (KPIs) for support teams. Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills, particularly in handling escalations and resolving conflicts with a collaborative approach. Technical Acumen: A technology-centric background with familiarity in application troubleshooting practices and tools like case management, knowledge bases, and defect management. Problem-Solving: Strong logical, analytical, and problem-solving skills to effectively manage and resolve complex Issues What You’ll Get Competitive salary. Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/) Equal employment opportunities. Opportunity to build with a pre-IPO Global SaaS Centaur
